title: Adaptation Price for Multi-Dose Policy Regret under Effect Cancellation
banked_reason: Sound supporting results, verified citations, and a route-specific inverse obstruction leave the sharp adaptation price unresolved; incremental result below the field floor.
gap_reasons: The headlined sharp all-procedure intrinsic-oracle price is still posed as open; the delivered constant lower floor and loose n^(3/10) bracket neither evaluate a_n nor construct the required matching learner/converse, so the current kernel is not yet the promised theorem-level contribution.

The certified bracket establishes only c ≤ A_n ≤ C max{1,(n/64)^(3/10)}, with its upper side obtained from the ordinary worst-Hölder bound; it does not decide whether the price is bounded or divergent.
proof_attempt_summary: The selector derivation supplied supporting results and c <= A_n <= C max{1,(n/64)^(3/10)}, while leaving cross-scale residual transfer and sharp adaptation price open. After lawful citation verification, one targeted quotient-space third-order modulus/K-functional attempt found a legal C4 interior bump with modulus/K-functional of order h^3 and actual fixed-kernel residual of order h^4, refuting the proposed inverse route by h^-1. The original transfer theorem, an unconditional sharp-price learner, and a matching converse remain unresolved; the obstruction implies neither divergent price nor mathematical impossibility.
tldr: The sharp original-record adaptation price \(\mathcal A_n\) remains undetermined. The established native comparison learner and positive testing floor give the explicit bracket \(c\le\mathcal A_n\le C\max\{1,(n/64)^{3/10}\}\). This round certifies a precise obstruction to the proposed third-order quotient strong-converse route: one legal smooth interior bump has third-order modulus of order \(h^3\) and actual public-kernel residual of order \(h^4\). The original cross-scale residual inequality and boundedness of the price remain open.
gap: GL2011 already admits actual norm bias. Its commuting double-smoother construction and Young domination do not establish the required boundary-simplex transfer in \(\mathcal N\). Ai--Fang--Xie2026 uses a Fourier envelope and a smoothness-consistency event in a different model. Neither inspected result evaluates \(\mathcal A_n\).
fill: Open-ended Question \(\mathrm{oeq:sharp\mbox{-}price}\) requires an evaluated order, an attaining original-record procedure, and a matching unrestricted converse. The residual-transfer question and original-likelihood testing geometry provide complementary handles. A correction replaces the intrinsic benchmark only when a proved divergent price calls for it.
